reader_job.quick_read: Three teammates see what the plan commits to and answer the two open decisions in place.

Two decisions are still open and belong to the reviewers: the rollout order (internal ring, then 10%, then 100% over a week, recommended; or straight to 100% behind a kill switch) and the retry policy for a failed sync (retry 3 times, 5 minutes apart, recommended; or no automatic retry, the user presses Try again). reader_job.deep_audit: Check every rail control, mode layout, code excerpt and dark thumbnail against the kit rules.

evals.prompt: /vpk-html Build a two-column story explainer of how our board reflows when a card leaves a column, for the platform team. Source is files/board-src/; quote the reflow code from it. Offer Page, Slides, X Threads and Video, with a contact sheet of the figure in light and dark.
evals.expected_output: A single offline HTML story explainer whose four modes, rail controls, code excerpts and dark thumbnails follow the kit.
expectations: Every rail button is at least 44×44 with a 15px icon, carries aria-label plus data-tip, and the page has zero [title] attributes on controls.
In X Threads the first visible step is 01, with no h1 above it.
In Video at 1440×900 and 390×844, scrollHeight <= innerHeight and no title or chapter line is visible.
Each code block’s lines equal the cited source lines, and the page ships no highlighter script.
In the dark contact sheet, thumbnail ink percentages equal the live figure’s.
The light and dark contact sheets and every other capture sit under output/vpk-html/; artifacts/vpk-html/<slug>/ holds only the HTML, its <slug>.content.json and _figures/ tests.
human_rubric: Slides read as a centred carousel, one chapter per slide.
Video fits one viewport with Generate in the timeline row.
Dark thumbnails read as the same figure as the live one.
